title: both sides have to show up.

body.text: from the recording: we need to wake up ~ our future depends on what we do next.
this is not a blame note. two things can be true. something was placed between us. we still decide what happens next.

i am 30. i left the porch early. community, teams, the street, the long walk from boyhood to manhood. so when i speak on men and women, i am not repeating a timeline. i am reporting what i have watched, and what comes back when i say it out loud.
the fear is on both sides. the fear of stepping up to the future we claim we want. men are not fully showing up. women are not fully showing up. that is the observation. not a verdict on one gender.

for the men, a lot of us were handed a script that was never built for us. provide. protect. show up. she does not respect you. provide. protect. show up. no one taught the other half. how to be seen. how to require respect. how to choose a woman who can actually build a life.

a lot of us did not have a father in the room. a lot of us did not have a mother who could be a mother, because she was busy being both. so the lesson arrived late. at 30 you look up and realize the training did not match the life.

for the women, the turn is harder to say and still has to be said. if the men who did not show up are the men you resent, and you become those men, who is left to show up? that is the loop. two groups talking about the problem. neither group taking the plate.

then the public conversation stays in the wound. a husband can say you are still beautiful. the comments can still choose the struggle. victim mindset moves faster than accountability. men do not own what their absence cost. women do not own what their choices cost. both point. the future does not get built in a pointing match.

i can already see where that road goes. fewer black families. more people choosing outside the community, or choosing no one. not because we started out hating each other. because something was set between us, and we have been feeding it. 2026 is not the beginning. it is the generation living inside the implant.

so the talk has to change. not another 50/50 argument. not another decade spent in 1997. trust the people who are talking about the future. commit to the goal. ask what we invest in. make the plan. weekly. monthly. boring on purpose.

and use the tools. people are scared of super intelligence because it can take a job. then they refuse to use it for the question their whole family never got answered. that is not caution. that is refusing the future.
the useful conversations do not come with drama. they do not come with trauma. they do not come with a villain. that is why they stay in private rooms. those are the ones that move us.
if you want the old frequency, keep it. if you want a different one, connect, then build. some people will not come. leave them. meet the ones who can hold what we are trying to make.
your attention matters. thank you for bringing it here.
